description: This file defines an abstract class 'Properties' within the PhpSpreadsheet chart namespace, encapsulating various styling and visual properties for chart elements, such as colors, shadow effects, line styles, and formatting codes. It provides methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as converting certain property values to and from XML representations. It appears to serve as a base class for more specific chart property classes.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Abstract class that manages visual styling properties for chart elements, including colors, shadows, borders, line styles, and formats, providing methods to set and retrieve these properties, as well as converting values to XML-compatible strings.

methods.name: pointsToXml
methods.description: Converts a float point size to an XML string representation by multiplying with POINTS_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: xmlToPoints
methods.description: Converts an XML string representation of points back to a float value by dividing by POINTS_WIDTH_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: angleToXml
methods.description: Converts a float angle to its XML string representation by multiplying with ANGLE_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: xmlToAngle
methods.description: Converts an XML angle string back to a float by dividing by ANGLE_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: tenthOfPercentToXml
methods.description: Converts a float percentage value to XML representation by multiplying with PERCENTAGE_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: xmlToTenthOfPercent
methods.description: Converts an XML percentage value back to float by dividing by PERCENTAGE_MULTIPLIER.

methods.name: setGlowProperties
methods.description: Sets glow size and color properties for the object.

methods.name: getGlowProperty
methods.description: Retrieves specific glow property such as size or color.

methods.name: getGlowColor
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object representing the glow color.

methods.name: getGlowColorObject
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object for glow color.

methods.name: getGlowSize
methods.description: Returns the glow size as a float.

methods.name: setGlowSize
methods.description: Sets the glow size property.

methods.name: setSoftEdges
methods.description: Sets the soft edges size property.

methods.name: getSoftEdgesSize
methods.description: Retrieves the soft edges size value.

methods.name: setShadowProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific shadow property, such as color.

methods.name: setShadowProperties
methods.description: Sets various shadow properties, including presets, color, blur, angle, and distance.

methods.name: getShadowColorObject
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object representing the shadow color.

methods.name: getShadowProperty
methods.description: Retrieves shadow property values, including color and other attributes.

methods.name: getShadowArray
methods.description: Returns an array of shadow properties, including color if usable.

methods.name: getLineColor
methods.description: Returns the ChartColor object for the line color.

methods.name: setLineColorProperties
methods.description: Sets line color properties with specified value, alpha, and type.

methods.name: getLineColorProperty
methods.description: Gets a specific property of the line color.

methods.name: setLineStyleProperties
methods.description: Sets various line style properties including width, dash, cap, join, and arrow options.

methods.name: setLineStyleArray
methods.description: Sets multiple line style properties at once from an associative array.

methods.name: setLineStyleProperty
methods.description: Sets a single line style property.

methods.name: getLineStyleArray
methods.description: Retrieves the current line style properties as an array.

methods.name: getLineStyleProperty
methods.description: Fetches a specific line style property.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowParameters
methods.description: Retrieves the size parameter of arrow styles.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowWidth
methods.description: Gets the arrow width property for a given arrow type.

methods.name: getLineStyleArrowLength
methods.description: Gets the arrow length property for a given arrow type.
